home.lead: School readiness is a crucial phase in a child's development: the skills and competencies that prepare them for a smooth and successful move into grade 1.
home.aboutSkills: The skills and abilities a child needs include cognitive skills such as basic literacy and numeracy, and emotional and social competencies like self-regulation, cooperation and communication.
home.aboutChild: A child who is school ready can follow instructions, interact positively with peers and teachers, and adapt to the structured environment of a classroom. Getting there is a shared effort by parents, educators and the community, who provide the enriching experiences and support that build these skills.
home.frameworkIntro: Children's development is observed across six domains, each made up of a few competencies.
home.closingFoundation: School readiness lays the foundation for a child's lifelong learning and success. A good early childhood education programme offers an age-appropriate and developmentally suitable learning environment for all children, so that every 6-year-old is school ready when they enter primary school.
home.closingTool: This tool helps ECE educators provide the early learning experiences each child needs, based on their individual developmental journey.

classification.name: Classification
classification.description: Sorting and grouping objects by shared features such as colour, shape and size.

levels.beginning: Unable to sort objects based on any characteristic
levels.progressing: Sorts objects based on any one characteristic
levels.advancing: Classifies objects based on any two characteristics
levels.schoolReady: Classifies objects based on three characteristics

patterns.name: Patterns
patterns.description: Noticing, copying and continuing repeating patterns in objects, sounds and movements.

number-concept.name: Number Concept
number-concept.description: Understanding quantity, counting with meaning and recognising numerals.

levels.progressing: Connects a number with an object and counts each object with understanding
levels.advancing: Identifies numerals and can link them with concrete objects
levels.schoolReady: Identifies both the smallest and the largest numerals within 1 to 10

seriation.name: Seriation
seriation.description: Comparing and arranging objects in order of size, length or quantity.

levels.beginning: Unable to compare two objects in terms of size, length, or quantity
levels.progressing: Compares two similar objects based on size, length, or quantity
levels.advancing: Arranges up to three objects by size, length, or quantity
levels.schoolReady: Arranges up to five objects by size, length, or quantity

vocabulary-and-expression.name: Vocabulary and Expression
vocabulary-and-expression.description: Using a growing range of words and sentences to share ideas and describe events.

levels.beginning: Uses gestures to express/describe any event
levels.progressing: Uses words to express/describe any event
levels.advancing: Uses incomplete sentences to express/describe any event
levels.schoolReady: Uses complete sentences to express/describe any event

listening-comprehension.name: Listening Comprehension
listening-comprehension.description: Listening with attention and understanding stories and conversations.

levels.beginning: Does not pay attention to a story/conversation
levels.advancing: Understands a story/conversation – responds to simple/close-ended questions (e.g., what, when, who)
levels.schoolReady: Understands a story/conversation – responds to complex/open-ended questions (e.g., why and how)

emergent-reading--book-handling.name: Emergent Reading & Book Handling
emergent-reading--book-handling.description: Exploring books, telling pictures from text and following print in the right direction.

levels.beginning: Picks up books and explores them
levels.progressing: Identifies the cover page of a book

emergent-writing.name: Emergent Writing
emergent-writing.description: Moving from scribbles and drawings towards writing letters and words to express ideas.

levels.advancing: Engages in make-believe writing by using a combination of drawing and writing to express an idea
levels.schoolReady: Uses inventive spelling (based on phonics) to write words that are connected to a given topic

gross-motor-development.name: Gross Motor Development
gross-motor-development.description: Balance, coordination and control of the large muscles while running, jumping and throwing.

levels.beginning: Limited balance in gross motor activities, e.g., jumping
levels.progressing: Maintains balance in gross motor activities
levels.advancing: Maintains balance and controls body while moving quickly
levels.schoolReady: Balances and coordinates well in a variety of activities, such as throwing a ball with aim or kicking a ball at a given target

fine-motor-development.name: Fine Motor Development
fine-motor-development.description: Control and coordination of the small muscles of the hands and fingers.

levels.beginning: Limited coordination of small muscles in fine motor activities
levels.progressing: Maintains coordination of small muscles in fine motor activities
levels.advancing: Maintains coordination of small muscles while manipulating objects
levels.schoolReady: Controls and coordinates well in a variety of small muscle activities

interaction.name: Interaction
interaction.description: Playing and working together with other children and adults.

levels.beginning: Plays alongside or near others but not with others
levels.advancing: Plays with others to make/create something jointly
levels.schoolReady: Engages in games with rules with other children

sharing-with-others.name: Sharing with Others
sharing-with-others.description: Willingly sharing materials, space and attention with peers.

levels.beginning: Shares unwillingly with peers and only when asked
levels.progressing: Begins to share selectively when encouraged
levels.advancing: Comes forward and shares with selected/few peers
levels.schoolReady: Comes forward and shares with all/any peers on her/his own

emotional-expression-and-regulation.name: Emotional Expression and Regulation
emotional-expression-and-regulation.description: Recognising feelings and responding to them in appropriate ways.

levels.schoolReady: Gives appropriate response to her/his emotions

initiative.name: Initiative
initiative.description: Starting activities and trying new things without being asked.

levels.beginning: Does not take action even after being asked to do something
levels.progressing: Begins to take initiative when encouraged
levels.advancing: Takes initiative in some activities which she/he likes
levels.schoolReady: Takes initiative readily in most/all of the classroom activities

task-persistence.name: Task Persistence
task-persistence.description: Staying focused on an activity until it is finished, even with distractions.

levels.beginning: Focuses on play activities for a short period of time (about 5 minutes)
levels.progressing: Engages in play activities for about 10 minutes
levels.advancing: Sustains focus in play activities for about 15 minutes
levels.schoolReady: Sustains focus in play activities for at least 20-25 minutes, even if there are distractions

creative-expression.name: Creative Expression
creative-expression.description: Expressing ideas through art, craft, music, dance and play.

levels.beginning: Unable to create something to represent an idea or object (e.g., by using arts and crafts, dance or music)
levels.progressing: Creates something with an adult assistance
levels.schoolReady: Creates something innovative to represent an idea or object

imagination.name: Imagination
imagination.description: Pretend play, storytelling and thinking about what could happen next.

levels.beginning: Unable to answer questions about what would happen next in a story
levels.progressing: Answers questions about what would happen next in a story
levels.advancing: Role-plays characters in a story or uses props to tell a story
levels.schoolReady: Makes up and tells own story

beginning.label: Beginning
beginning.generic: The child shows initial attempts with limited success. Assess based on effort and support needed.

progressing.label: Progressing
progressing.generic: The child shows improvement with some support. Assess based on progress and guidance needed.

advancing.label: Advancing
advancing.generic: The child shows good understanding and application. Assess based on mastery and independence.

schoolReady.label: School Ready
schoolReady.generic: The child masters the task and applies it in context. Assess based on readiness for next stage.
